note: Two tracks per frame: main (the left hand, far arm) and off (the right hand, near arm). x and y are fractions of one frame from its top left. Item length is a share of the frame WIDTH. a is degrees, 0 = item points up, clockwise is positive. front=false means the item is drawn behind the body. hide=true means no item on that frame. w squashes the item sideways (1 = normal width). Draw order: items behind (main, off), body, items in front (main, off), then the hand over each item in front whose overlay is true: only the hand's own pixels from the body frame, namely the pixels of the skin colour found around the mark (same hue, inside a circle of radius fist x frame width, connected to the mark), grown by 2 px to take in the outline; when no skin colour is found near the mark it is the whole circle. Each animation has offItem: what its off hand carries (kind shield, other = a second weapon or item, or none = no off-hand item, in which case the off track is all null) with its own length, pivot and overlay; for the off hand it takes precedence over the character-level items.off.
